claim: A snapshot can carry a stored interface-detection result (Kempston present or absent), so choose the snapshot moment and clear or force the flag at start.

evidence.text: Full build: Kempston enabled (7A8B cleared, NR 05 mode 001).
Byte 62569 = 255 in every 128K dump enables Kempston, read as well as the keys; the keyboard always works: use the keyboard snapshot.
evidence.quote: Byte 62569 = 255 in every 128K dump: Kempston is read as well as the keys (0xF449); the keyboard always works.
